x: Later, at the "Black Swan", the Poly and Surrey A.C. found to their surprise that Gerry and the Pacemakers were still in very good voice The high spirits prevailed to the Social on the 26th October when we had well over 100 people in attendance.

Well, with Geoff North and John Thresher running into form at the right time Gerry should get peak support. At the time of writing Fairclough and Major seem to be humming along and Mann is just the runner to give them all a great start.

Last year, Gerry was 17th, and is perfectly capable of leading the team again with a place in the first 20. Now over the past four years, here are the best positions of some of our other runners, and these are not necessarily the best of which they are capable:
Leading for the first mile, Gerry was then caught by Gary McIlroy of Epsom and Belgrave's Jim Estall, and the three fought tooth and nail, swapping the lead over the next three miles.
